items.title: SpaceX stock hits new closing low in rocky week ahead of earnings
items.summary: SpaceX stock whipsawed through a volatile week, swinging from an all-time low to a sharp rebound and closing at a new low, as investors braced for the newly public company's first earnings report and a major share unlock.

items.title: Tesla reportedly considering a spin off of its China business
items.summary: Tesla (TSLA) is reportedly considering a spin-off of its China business, according to the Wall Street Journal. This comes amid murmurs of a possible merger between the EV maker and Elon Musk's space venture SpaceX (SPCX).

items.title: Insurance ETFs Top Defensive Sector Chart In July As Investors Look To Pivot Slightly From Chips And AI
items.summary: Insurance ETFs are garnering attention as a defensive play as investors look to hedge against tech and AI.

items.title: Market Chatter: Musk's Fortune Falls Below Pre-SpaceX IPO Levels, Bloomberg Reports
items.summary: Elon Musk's net worth has fallen below where it stood before SpaceX's initial public offering priced

items.title: Stock Market Today, July 31: Rivian Beats Q2 Revenue Estimate as Concerns of Rising Costs Weigh on Stock
items.summary: Today, July 31, 2026, the EV maker beat expectations with $1.66 billion in quarterly sales, yet investors focused on profitability headwinds and sector weakness.

items.title: TSLL: How Tesla Investors Lose Money Even When the Stock Goes Up
items.summary: TSLL promises to double Tesla's gains, but a hidden mechanical flaw means investors can watch their portfolios shrink even as the underlying stock climbs higher. Understanding this flaw could save you from a costly mistake.

items.title: Winners and Losers in Tech Stocks This Week
items.summary: Over the past two days, four of the trillion-dollar tech giants have reported earnings. Each day, there's been one clear winner and one clear loser. Today, Amazon stock was the winner while Apple shares fell.

items.title: Elon Musk Cools Off Tesla-SpaceX Merger Speculation as SpaceX Stock Hits Record Low
items.summary: The Wall Street Journal reports Tesla is considering selling its China business to facilitate a future merger with SpaceX.
